data.title: Maverick Gold and Silver Announces Closing of First Tranche of Non-Brokered Private Placement for Gross Proceeds of C$554,000
data.description:
Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 16, 2026) - Maverick Gold and Silver Corp., (FSE: VR61) (OTC Pink: VRCFF) ("Maverick" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has closed the first tranche (the "First Tranche") of its non-brokered private placement previously announced on October 8, 2026 (the "Offering"), issuing 11,080,000 units of the Company (each, a "Unit") at a price of C$0.05 per Unit for gross proceeds of C$554,000 under the First Tranche.

The Company intends to use the net proceeds of the Offering for working capital requirements and general corporate purposes. The Units were offered to purchasers in reliance on available prospectus exemptions under applicable Canadian securities laws.

Offering Terms

Each Unit consists of one common share in the capital of the Company (each, a "Common Share") and one Common Share purchase warrant (each, a "Warrant"). Each Warrant entitles the holder thereof to purchase one additional Common Share at a price of C$0.10 until October 16, 2028; provided, however, that if, at any time prior to the expiry of the Warrants, the closing price of the Common Shares on the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "CSE") equals or exceeds C$0.15 per Common Share for a period of 10 consecutive trading days, the Company may, at its option, accelerate the expiry date of the Warrants by giving written notice to the holders thereof, and in such case, the Warrants will expire on the 30th day after the date on which such notice is given by the Company. All securities issued in connection with the First Tranche are subject to a statutory hold period expiring February 17, 2027, in accordance with applicable securities legislation.

In connection with the First Tranche, the Company paid finders' fees totaling C$22,000 in cash and issued an aggregate of 440,000 non-transferable warrants (the "Finder Warrants") to certain eligible finders. Each Finder Warrant entitles the holder thereof to purchase one Common Share at a price of C$0.10 until October 16, 2028.

The Company anticipates closing one or more subsequent tranches of the Offering.

The securities issued pursuant to the Offering have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or any applicable state securities laws, and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from registration. This news release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy, nor will there be any sale of the securities in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful.

About Maverick Gold and Silver Corp.

Maverick Gold and Silver Corp. (FSE: VR61) (OTC Pink: VRCFF) is an exploration-stage company advancing a portfolio of gold, silver and copper properties in Nevada and British Columbia. The Company is focused on advancing its exploration projects through systematic exploration and drilling.

Additional information about Maverick Gold and Silver is available on the Company's website at www.maverickgoldsilver.com.

data.title: FAA poised to approve Boeing 737 MAX 10 as soon as next week - Reuters
data.description:
The Federal Aviation Administration ‌is set to approve the long-delayed Boeing 737 MAX 10 as soon as next week after completing a key safety review, Reuters reported Friday.

In one of the last steps prior to final approval, the FAA and Boeing reportedly held a successful meeting Friday of the Type Certification Board, which is comprised of agency management team members.

Airlines have ordered nearly 1,500 MAX 10s, and the model accounts for ~30% of Boeing's outstanding ​737 backlog, but numerous delays have helped European rival Airbus' A321neo secure a greater share of the large single-aisle market.

A glitch with the latest update ​of the 737 ⁠MAX's navigation software threatened to further delay certification when Boeing disclosed it last month, but the FAA determined it did not pose a safety concern and did not require a fix as ​a condition of certifying the plane.

Boeing is still working on certifying ​the 777-9, its largest jetliner in production and six years behind schedule.

data.title: Moderna Stock Slumps as Biotech Rally Takes a Breather-but It's Too Early to Panic — Barrons.com
Hyperscale Data Plans for askROI Subsidiary to Go Public
data.description:
By Elias Schisgall

Hyperscale Data's artificial-intelligence technology subsidiary, askROI, plans to go public in the second or third quarter of next year.

The AI data center company said askROI may go public through an initial public offering, reverse takeover, or merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

As part of the planned deal, Hyperscale Data Executive Chairman Milton "Todd" Ault III will step down as chief executive of askROI. The subsidiary is expected to appoint Joseph Spaziano as CEO and Ryan Doucette as president, and Hyperscale Data added that it anticipates both will stay on once askROI goes public.

Spaziano currently serves as president and chief operating officer of askROI and chief technology officer of the parent company. He is expected to step down from the latter role to focus entirely on askROI.

Hyperscale Data said the move builds on its strategy of positioning its operating businesses for independent growth and separate market valuations.

"We believe there is incredible value in askROI, which is currently not being recognized by the public markets while it is a subsidiary of Hyperscale Data," Ault said.

data.title: Stocks slip as dollar heads for weekly loss
data.description:
Key points:
  • US dollar heads for weekly loss on lower US Treasury yields
  • Bond markets stabilize after rush for safe havens on Thursday
  • Investors worry about debt risks in AI-related stocks

By Chibuike Oguh and Elizabeth Howcroft

Global stocks fell modestly on Friday as markets stabilized after a sharp tech-led selloff, while the dollar headed for a weekly loss.

Markets have been rattled this week by concerns over higher interest rates and the debt-fuelled financing behind the AI boom, triggering a selloff in technology and chip stocks.

Traders increased bets on further US rate hikes after stronger-than-expected inflation data was released on Wednesday, while investors piled in to Treasuries and other government bonds.

On Wall Street, the benchmark S&P 500 and the Nasdaq finished down and notched weekly losses. The Dow fell as well after reversing early gains but still scored a weekly gain.

Technology and communication services drove losses while the top gainers were utilities and energy stocks.

CoreWeave's shares shed 12% and lost about 25% this week amid increasing investor scrutiny of the financing for the massive AI infrastructure buildout.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.34%, the S&P 500 CBOE:SPX lost 1.09%, and the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.1%.

The MSCI World Equity Index lost 0.40% and notched a weekly loss EURONEXT:IACWI.

European stock indexes, hit less hard by Thursday's selloff, gained, with the STOXX 600 adding 0.72% . London's FTSE 100 CURRENCYCOM:UK100 rose 0.38%. Both indexes finished the week higher.

"We're starting to see some cracks in the financing of data centers because you're not too sure who's going to be the winners," said Tom Plumb, portfolio manager at Plumb Balanced Fund.

"Our view is that there's going to be some really significant winners," he said. "But you have to be careful on the financing capability because companies don't get into trouble because their assets don't exceed their liabilities. They get into trouble when they have liquidity issues."

Asian stocks mostly rose, and bond markets steadied, with investors reversing some of the previous session's moves.

Indonesian equities suffered their biggest drop since 1998 after index provider MSCI said the country's market no longer merited emerging-market status and outlined plans to remove it from key indexes tracked by funds.

DOLLAR FALLS

The dollar index fell 0.26% and was on track for its first weekly decline after four weeks of gains, as lower Treasury yields reduced the currency's appeal. Further worries about AI would push the dollar down further, analysts said.

The euro rose from its recent 17-month low. It was last up 0.16% at $1.1238 .

The Japanese yen rose 0.01% against the greenback to 157.98 per dollar.

European government bond yields edged higher, while US bond yields reversed earlier declines. Germany's 10-year yield rose 1.14 basis points to 3.421% (DE10YT=RR). The yield on benchmark US 10-year notes rose 0.17 basis points to 5.085%.

Even so, yields have eased this week as investors sought the safety of government debt amid concerns about AI-related companies' finances. G7 government bond markets were on course for their strongest weekly performance since late May.

Brent crude futures rose 3.72% to settle at $109.86 a barrel and were headed for a second straight weekly gain amid concerns over Middle East supplies. Attacks around the Strait of Hormuz have surged in the past 10 days.

Gold (XAU) gained support from the weaker dollar, rising 0.07% to $4,167.14 an ounce.

data.title: Pacific Imperial Announces Private Placement Cancellation Due to Re-Pricing Requirement
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

Vancouver, British Columbia – October 16, 2026 – TheNewswire - Pacific Imperial Mines Inc. (TSX.V: PPM) (“Pacific Imperial” or the “Company”) announces that it is cancelling its proposed private placement (the “Private Placement”) of flow-through units and non-flow-through units, as previously described in the Company’s press release dated September 9, 2026. After an internal review conducted by the TSX Venture Exchange (the “TSXV”) completed on October 15, 2026, the TSXV determined that the closing price of $0.10 (after adjusting for the consolidation), which was used to establish the issue price of $0.075 for the Private Placement, was not a fair reflection of the market price for the Company’s common shares, and confirmed that the Company would need to reprice the Private Placement.

The TSXV advised the Company on October 8th that the reserve price established was not a fair reflection of the market price for the Company’s common shares and the offering would need to be repriced. The Company advised the TSXV on October 9th that the re-pricing would be unacceptable to the committed subscribers.

The Company thoroughly reviewed its strategic options and confirmed that a mandate to reprice the Private Placement would cause existing subscribers to withdraw their commitments from the Private Placement. Accordingly, the Company has decided to formally cancel the proposed Private Placement and will be re-evaluating how to move forward.

About Pacific Imperial Mines

Pacific Imperial is a mineral exploration company based in Vancouver, Canada, engaged in the acquisition, exploration, evaluation and development of mineral properties in an acceptable risk environment. The Company’s current focus is on the Babine and Fenton properties in B.C. and the Brownell Property in Saskatchewan.

data.title: Emerging Growth Research Publishes Update on Newton Golf’s Pole Canyon Option and Critical Minerals Strategy
data.description:
NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Emerging Growth Research ("EGR") today announced the publication of a company-sponsored Flash Report covering Newton Golf Company, Inc. , a technology-focused golf equipment company that develops and sells premium golf shafts, putters and related products.

The report examines Newton Golf's recently announced option to acquire the Pole Canyon project, a historic beryllium-tungsten property located in White Pine County, Nevada. It also discusses the Company's move into the U.S. critical minerals sector and the effect of the associated share issuance on EGR's earnings-per-share estimates.

Key Highlights

  • Pole Canyon Option - On September 24, 2026, Newton Golf announced it had completed a transaction granting it an option to acquire the Pole Canyon project, a historic beryllium-tungsten property in White Pine County, Nevada. The transaction represents the Company's entry into the U.S. critical minerals sector.
  • Consideration - In connection with the option, Newton Golf issued shares equal to 19.9% of its issued and outstanding common stock. Using EGR's previous estimate of shares outstanding at the end of Q3:26, the issuance is estimated at approximately 1.13 million shares.
  • Critical Minerals - Beryllium appears on the U.S. Geological Survey's 2025 List of Critical Minerals, while tungsten is included on the U.S. Department of Energy's 2023 Final Critical Materials List. Both materials have applications in aerospace, defense and advanced manufacturing.
  • Project Overview - Pole Canyon is a past-producing property comprising 16 unpatented lode claims across approximately 330 acres, about 50 miles southeast of Ely, Nevada. Historical materials describe a mineralized system extending for more than 4,000 feet and reportedly open along strike and at depth. They also cite a historical estimate of approximately 281,725 tons grading 0.75% beryllium oxide and 0.30% tungsten trioxide. Newton Golf has not independently verified these historical estimates.
  • Strategy - Newton Golf has stated that it does not plan to begin mining operations at this time. The Company instead intends to consider potential strategic agreements, with the option structure providing exposure to the project while limiting near-term operating and capital commitments.
  • Estimate Updates - EGR does not expect the transaction to affect the Company's revenue or operating income and has not changed its revenue forecasts. Reflecting the additional shares outstanding, EGR's FY:26 loss-per-share estimate narrows to $(1.23) from $(1.37), and its FY:27 estimate narrows to $(0.38) from $(0.42).
  • Risks - Newton Golf continues to generate negative cash flow and may need to obtain additional capital to support its growth plans. Demand for its products may be affected by shifts in consumer preferences and sentiment, as golf equipment is discretionary. The Pole Canyon option is at an early stage, mining is not currently underway, and there can be no assurance the project will generate value for the Company.

data.title: ATLANTIC AMERICAN CORP FY 2025: Revenue $210.4M, EPS $0.28— 10-K Summary
data.description:
Atlantic American Corp reported fiscal 2025 revenue of $210.4M and net income of $6.02M, or diluted EPS of $0.28, reversing a net loss in 2024 as underwriting improvements, higher premiums and investment gains supported profitability.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $210.4M, compared with $188.1M in the prior year; YoY change 11.9%.
  • Net income was $6.02M, compared with $(1.39M) in the prior year.
  • Diluted EPS was $0.28, compared with $(0.09) in the prior year.

Business Highlights

  • Consolidated revenue rose to $210.4M from $188.1M, driven by higher property & casualty and Medicare Supplement premiums.
  • Auto liability rate increases and new inland marine programs boosted P&C writings.
  • Medicare Supplement new sales increased in the life & health segment, supporting growth.
  • Underwriting performance improved: American Southern’s combined ratio improved to 99.1% from 105.4%, and Bankers Fidelity maintained a 97.5% combined ratio.
  • The company identified a material weakness in premium receivable controls, restated 2024 figures and has implemented remediation steps to strengthen reconciliations.
  • Net investment income rose and equity unrealized gains contributed to 2025 profitability alongside increased earned premiums.

Original SEC Filing: ATLANTIC AMERICAN CORP [ AAME ] - 10-K - Oct. 16, 2026

BTIG raised its price target on Twilio from $285 to $315 and reiterated a Buy rating. The firm said anticipation of Twilio's S&P 500 inclusion, announced on October 1, and growing enthusiasm around personal AI agents have lifted the shares about 16% over the past six weeks. Twilio shares rose 1.50% in premarket.

BTIG expects near-term revenue from personal AI agents to be modest and mostly tied to Verify use cases. Further out, it sees agents opening up two-way messaging, outbound AI voice and cross-channel orchestration, along with new opportunities in identity. Recent meetings with management strengthened the firm's view of Twilio as the communications infrastructure layer for AI agents.

BTIG added that third-party data points to healthy demand, leaving room for upside to organic growth estimates. It kept Twilio as its top large-cap software pick and described the shares as both offensive and defensive in the current market.

data.title: TSX rises as oil stocks gain on Brent touching $110 a barrel
data.description:
Canada's main stock index gained on Friday, boosted by oil stocks, while investors assessed Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem's warning on persistent energy-price pressures on interest rates.

The S&P/TSX Composite Index gained 0.11% to 36,176.55, touching its highest level since September 4. The index gained 1.44% in the week.

  • Energy stocks rose 2.8%. Brent touched $110 a barrel for the first time since May on worries that escalating tensions in the Middle East could further tighten supplies.

  • South of the border, Wall Street ended sharply lower, with CoreWeave, Broadcom and other AI-related technology stocks under renewed pressure.

  • In Canada, technology stocks <.SPTTTK> fell 3.5%, dragged down by a 5% fall in Shopify and 7.7% decline in BlackBerry .

  • "It's (AI trade) probably affecting the TSX to a significantly lesser extent than it's affecting some of the US indices... there's a pretty big disparity between tech and everything else at the moment," said Josh Sheluk, CIO at Verecan Capital Management.

  • "The TSX offers a pretty interesting diversifying investment relative to global stocks because it is a lot more heavily allocated and weighted towards not only energy but materials as well," Sheluk said.

  • Macklem said Canada has not raised interest rates yet but the longer elevated energy prices go on "the harder that gets".

  • The BoC is not expected to raise interest rates at its next monetary policy decision announcement on October 28, but money markets are pricing in a rate hike of 25 basis points in December, according to data compiled by LSEG.

  • Data on the day showed that Canadian home sales extended their decline in September, after a drop in August, as higher mortgage rates and expectations of a rate hike weighed on demand.

data.title: Bloom Energy Supports Central Texas First Responders Ahead of Florida-Texas Matchup
data.description:
Bloom Energy () continued its season-long partnership with ESPN Radio’s College Football Campus Tour this week in Austin, Texas.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261016766768/en/

Ahead of the Florida-Texas matchup, Bloom visited Austin Fire Department Station #3 and presented a $10,000 donation to the Central Texas Public Safety Commission, a nonprofit organization that supports police, fire and EMS departments across Central Texas.

For more than 25 years, the Central Texas Public Safety Commission has worked with first responders and community partners to identify and fund critical needs, including equipment, training, wellness programs and community initiatives that strengthen public safety.

“Every community’s resilience ultimately depends on people,” said Natalie Sunderland, Chief Marketing Officer at Bloom Energy. “The firefighters, EMS personnel and first responders supported by the Central Texas Public Safety Commission are the people communities turn to on their hardest days. We are proud to support an organization that helps ensure they have the resources they need to serve Central Texas.”

“The Central Texas Public Safety Commission provides critical support for equipment, training and other needs that fall outside our normal operating budget,” said Austin Interim Fire Chief Tom Vocke. “Support from organizations like Bloom Energy helps supplement city resources and ensures our firefighters have what they need to stay safe and ready to respond.”

Austin Fire Department Station #3 opened in 1957 and serves the University of Texas and surrounding Central Austin neighborhoods. The station reopened in October 2023 following a renovation that rebuilt its apparatus bays and added dedicated spaces designed to improve firefighter health and safety while preserving the station’s original design.

Bloom will also be on the University of Texas campus Saturday during pregame festivities, where fans can take part in an interactive experience and learn more about Bloom's work, providing clean, reliable power for essential services and critical infrastructure across the country.

data.title: WaFd Reports FY2026 Net Income $256M, FY EPS $3.21; Q4 Net Income $60M
data.description:
WaFd reported fiscal year 2026 net income of $255.9 million and diluted earnings per common share of $3.21, a 22% increase in EPS year-over-year. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, WaFd recorded net income of $59.99 million and diluted EPS of $0.76. The company noted improved asset quality following resolution of a large classified loan and completed significant investment security purchases while executing loan sales.

Financial Highlights

  • Fiscal year 2026 net income: $255,865,000.
  • Fiscal year 2026 diluted earnings per common share: $3.21 (22% increase vs. prior year $2.63).
  • Quarter (Q4 FY2026) net income: $59,991,000; diluted EPS: $0.76.
  • Net interest income for Q4: $182.4 million; net interest margin: 2.81%.
  • Q4 non-interest income: $38.1 million (including $16.4 million gain on sale of single-family loans); Q4 non-interest expense: $121.5 million; efficiency ratio: 55.12%.

Business Highlights

  • Total assets increased to $27.2 billion as of September 30, 2026, driven by $1.4 billion of investment securities purchases focused on discount-priced 30-year mortgage-backed securities.
  • Transaction deposits grew 4.6% year-over-year; transaction accounts comprised 60.4% of deposits as of September 30, 2026.
  • Net loans decreased to $19.04 billion due to loan-sale activity, including $543 million of single-family residential loan sales in Q4 and an agreement to sell $429 million of multifamily loans classified as held for sale.
  • Active loan originations totaled $5.5 billion for fiscal 2026 (95% commercial, 5% consumer); repayments offset originations with $3.9 billion in repayments during the year.
  • Asset quality improved following resolution of a $53 million loan relationship (resulting in a $36 million charge-off); non-performing assets and delinquencies decreased materially to 0.32% of total assets and 0.50% of total loans, respectively, as of September 30, 2026.

data.title: Coca-Cola, Visa and Mastercard Hit Records as Investors Rotate Out of Chip Stocks — Barrons.com
data.description:
By Paul R. La Monica

Chip stocks have fizzled, but investors are finding fresh highs outside tech. Call it the revenge of the old economy.

Coca-Cola, a quintessential consumer staples stock and longtime favorite of Warren Buffett and Berkshire Hathaway, hit a new all-time high this week. So did Visa and Mastercard, two top financials, as well as life insurance leader MetLife.

Over in the oil patch, Chevron, Shell and ConocoPhillips notched new all-time highs on Friday. Healthcare stocks Gilead Sciences, Thermo Fisher Scientific and McKesson recently hit record highs as well, as did consumer discretionary stocks Urban Outfitters, Williams-Sonoma and SharkNinja. (Chevron, Visa, Gilead Sciences and SharkNinja are all recent Barron's stock picks.)

What's missing? Tech — for the most part. Apple isn't far from a new all-time high. But the shift away from momentum-driven chip stocks, which were surging thanks to expectations of even more big spending on AI by the top hyperscalers, is a sign that investors are largely shrugging off the sector's slump. Chip stocks were on pace Friday to extend their losing streak to nine straight sessions.

"Rotation continues to be the theme," said Michael O'Rourke, chief market strategist at JonesTrading, in a report Thursday. O'Rourke has been vocal about how concentrated the market is but added in his report that it is encouraging to see that the S&P 500 isn't far from its record high despite the notable pullback in chip stocks.

Third-quarter earnings season, which kicked off in earnest this week with several reports from big banks and is set to continue next week with GE Aerospace, Netflix, Meta Platforms, Tesla and Procter & Gamble among the megacap highlights, could be another catalyst for a continued broadening of the rally.

Nicole Inui, head of equity strategy for the Americas at HSBC, said in a report that "unloved sectors," such as financials, and consumer discretionary and real estate could get a lift if companies report better-than-expected earnings and offer upbeat guidance.

"U.S. economic activity continues to hold up better than expected," Inui added. "Earnings leadership could broaden. That, in turn, would support wider participation in the market and an improvement in index breadth."

Valuations also appear reasonable enough to spark a broader rally if earnings for companies outside tech and AI come in stronger than expected. The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF is trading for less than 16 times earnings estimates for the next 12 months, a bigger-than-usual discount to the cap-weighted index.

"Robust earnings growth has remained widespread across the market this year and is even accelerating, which are facts investors may not fully appreciate," said Mike Dickson, head of research at Horizon, in a recent report.

"As earnings come in over the next several weeks, many market sectors may perk up and join the rally. With many stocks below their highs, continued strong earnings growth across sectors could lift more stocks and help the broader market rise in the coming months," Dickson added.

So investors who may be licking their wounds from the recent selloff in chip stocks should take some comfort from the fact that the rest of the market is starting to pick up the slack for semiconductors.

Write to Paul R. La Monica at paul.lamonica@barrons.com
